questions.question: A New Testament letter says God gave up His own Son for us all. What else will God do for us?

answers.text: Ask us to pay Him back
Hold back the rest for now

questions.question: A New Testament letter teaches that Christ Jesus is the one who will condemn believers. True or false?
A New Testament letter says that in trouble, famine and danger, believers are what through Christ who loved them?
A New Testament letter asks, "If God is for us, who can be against us?" What is the point?

answers.text: No one can stand against us
We must earn His help first
